overlap_features.definitions: Strict positive-width overlap against sample frozen geometry; distinct OTHER source identities and distinct OTHER detector families only. Same-family evidence excluded from BOTH counts.
overlap_features.asof_policy: All source versions available <= decision close installed before querying; latest version per identity; Phase 7 invalidation/expiry/version-end known <= decision removes only that version. Future retirements never applied early.
overlap_features.eligibility: Actual Phase 6 recency parameters since latest version (30/90/180 days, equality included unless Phase 7 has retired it); latest scheduled Phase 5 profile only, including empty slots and one-stride end-of-input freshness.
overlap_features.interpretation: Provisional evidence eligibility, NOT verified survival, strength or independent confirmations. Overlap is a predictor, never a target. Volume family counted once even if multiple profile areas overlap.
overlap_features.missing: Null only when sample has no decision timestamp; known decision with no eligible overlaps is zero.

runtime_measurement: Final generation plus built-in read-back validation; independent audits, tests and discarded initial runs excluded
training_filter: label_status == labeled AND split_status == eligible; features ONLY from model_features

targets.strong_zone: First creation only. Wait next 20 bars for first frozen-range intersection; exclude wrong/ambiguous approach or adverse close before touch (including decision close). Evaluate 24 bars including touch. 1 iff any 1.50 ATR favorable close AND no 0.50 ATR adverse close. Otherwise 0 only with complete valid response.
targets.scenario: First lifecycle touch per version within 20 bars. Decision at touch close; exclude already resolved. Next 12 bars only: first 0.75 ATR favorable close -> bounce, first 0.50 ATR adverse close -> breakout. Else full-horizon consolidation requires >=9 closes in zone +/-0.25 ATR and total range <= width+1.00 ATR. Otherwise unresolved/censored.
targets.thresholds: Bullish favorable measured above upper, adverse below lower; bearish favorable below lower, adverse above upper. Equality qualifies. No wick-order inference. ATR frozen separately at each model's decision.

split_policy: Decision-time years: train 2020-2023, validation 2024, test Jan-Aug 2025. Creation partition owns identity across both tasks. Purge label endpoints >= split end. Embargo first 176h of validation/test.
warnings: All thresholds provisional; no models fitted or preprocessing learned
A is conditional on eligible observed touch; exclusions are not weak labels
Frozen geometry outcomes are not live-zone survival; ignore later updates/invalidation for response labels
B uses lifecycle-observed first touches per version, not independent identities or retests
No observed B first touch can mean replacement, invalidation, expiry, no contact or EOF; it is not a negative
Neutral estimated volume profiles are context only; latest-profile overlap is included, not a volume strength label
Close-based outcomes ignore wick-hit ordering; ambiguous approaches are excluded
176h embargo is conservative for 4h horizons and unnecessarily large for shorter timeframes
Purging plus identity ownership reduces correlated leakage but does not remove all nearby-zone dependence
Missing predictor values remain null for later training-only preprocessing; missing/nonpositive decision ATR excludes labels
Audit timestamps, labels, source IDs and statuses are NOT predictors
